import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Define source file paths
    source_files = [
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_2/test_0.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_2/test_1.csv"
    ]

    # Define the target schema and dtypes explicitly for consistency
    target_columns = [
        'tripduration', 'starttime', 'stoptime', 'start station id', 'start station name',
        'start station latitude', 'start station longitude', 'end station id', 'end station name',
        'end station latitude', 'end station longitude', 'bikeid', 'usertype', 'birth year', 'gender'
    ]

    # Define dtypes for reading and enforcing schema
    dtypes = {
        'tripduration': 'int64',
        'starttime': 'string',
        'stoptime': 'string',
        'start station id': 'Int64',  # Nullable integer
        'start station name': 'string',
        'start station latitude': 'float64',
        'start station longitude': 'float64',
        'end station id': 'Int64',
        'end station name': 'string',
        'end station latitude': 'float64',
        'end station longitude': 'float64',
        'bikeid': 'Int64',
        'usertype': 'string',
        'birth year': 'Int64',
        'gender': 'Int64'
    }

    # List to hold dataframes from each source
    dfs = []

    for file_path in source_files:
        # Read CSV with specified dtypes where possible
        # For starttime and stoptime, read as string to preserve format
        df = pd.read_csv(file_path, dtype={
            'tripduration': 'int64',
            'start station id': 'Int64',
            'start station name': 'string',
            'start station latitude': 'float64',
            'start station longitude': 'float64',
            'end station id': 'Int64',
            'end station name': 'string',
            'end station latitude': 'float64',
            'end station longitude': 'float64',
            'bikeid': 'Int64',
            'usertype': 'string',
            'birth year': 'Int64',
            'gender': 'Int64'
        }, parse_dates=False)  # Do not parse dates, keep as string

        # Ensure starttime and stoptime are strings (some CSV readers may infer datetime)
        df['starttime'] = df['starttime'].astype(str)
        df['stoptime'] = df['stoptime'].astype(str)

        # Reorder columns to target schema order if needed
        df = df[target_columns]

        # Append to list
        dfs.append(df)

    # Concatenate all source dataframes vertically (union)
    target_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

    # Enforce dtypes again to ensure consistency after concat
    target_df = target_df.astype(dtypes)

    # Write the combined dataframe to the target CSV path without index
    target_df.to_csv(
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_2/target_multisource_cot.csv",
        index=False
    )

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
